title: Milly Mae's Cottage Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutMilly Mae’s Cottage ~ 214 Dogwood Street ~ Santa Rosa Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. Milly Mae’s Cottage is a refurbished, family-friendly home offering private pool (not heated) and an approximate 7-minute walk from both Seaside and the Dogwood/Thyme Beach Access. With 1,842 interior square feet, Milly Mae’s Cottage sleeps up to 10 and offers 3 bedrooms + bunk nook, 3 full baths, cozy screened porch and parking for 4 cars. On-street parking is not allowed, so please plan accordingly. Main Level: 3 Bedrooms. 3 Full Baths. Bunk Nook. Fully Equipped Kitchen. Dining Table seats up to 8. Bar Seating for 4. Laundry Closet. Living Room. Screened Porch. Private Pool (not heated). Please note: fireplace is decorative only (not for guest use). #1 En-Suite Bedroom has 2 bunks (4T), walk-in-shower. #2 "Bedroom" is the open Bunk Nook in hallway (2T). #3 Queen Bedroom, private access to hall bath, door to back screened porch, pack-n-play in closet. Hall Bath shared by #2 Bunk nook and #3 Bedroom, walk-in-shower. #4 En-Suite King Bedroom, walk-in shower, tub, door to back screened porch. Please note – no local channels on any Smart TV’s, streaming services available with guest account login. Living room fireplace decorative only (not for guest use). *Please note there is a new home under construction across the street from Milly Mae's Cottage as of October 2024. Amenities: Business Features Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 4 Smart TV’s (no local channels) Distinctive Features Private pool (not heated) 7-minute walk to Dogwood/Tyme beach access Hardwood and tile floors throughout 10’ ceilings throughout; vaulted living area Poolside Dining for 4 Beach Gear Credit General Features Parking for 4 vehicles (on-street parking is not allowed, so please plan accordingly) 1 King bed, 1 Queen bed, 3 bunk beds (6 Twins) 3 Full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, hair dryer, outdoor gas grill w/grill utensils, outdoor screened porch, porch furniture, private pool (not heated), pack-n-play. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, drip coffee maker, electric stove with glass top, refrigerator with ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Seaside (1/4th mile) Grayton Beach (3.3 miles) State Parks (Tops'l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
